answer: Require every identity to renew a memory-hard proof of work each epoch. The registry publishes a fresh random seed, like a comet arriving unannounced, so nothing is precomputed. Each agent hashes its public key with that seed using a function needing 2 GB of RAM and submits within ten minutes; only valid submissions keep voting rights. Memory cannot be shared, so a karst field of fakes needs a basalt-solid server slice apiece, about four dollars monthly.
